name: Deacon Vane
blurb: A preacher in a duster on a chopper.

look.description: A tall preacher in a long black duster and a flat-brimmed hat, Bible strapped to the tank. Rides a long, low chopper with ape-hanger bars.

meta.notes: Regular. M4 rivals-1 (built early): a heavy hitter, slow off the line, hunts you first, then his rival, then anyone near. Rivalry: Chad Speedwell, a false prophet with better lighting. Prefers the chain (weapons-2 adds it). Rides the starter bike until his chopper exists; the look block is data for render. Approved line: "Pray the ditch is soft, sinner."
